question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**effectively**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the benefits of time management.
 
• The word to fill the blank should describe *how* people manage their time to achieve their goals.
 
• "Effectively" means in a way that produces the intended result, which accurately describes successful time management.
 
• The other options do not accurately describe the manner in which time is managed.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Effective time management is (1) crucial__ for success. By prioritising tasks, individuals can enhance (2)__**productivity**__ and reduce stress. Planning allows for a balance (3) __**between **__work and personal life. Studies show that those who manage their time (4) __**effectively **__are more likely to achieve their goals. It is a skill (5)____positively impacts both professional and personal aspects of life.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Efficient** (कुशल): "Efficient" means doing something in a way that achieves the maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense. While related to good time management, it doesn't describe the *action* of managing time.
 
• **Strongly** (मजबूती से): "Strongly" means in a powerful way, which doesn't fit the context of managing time.
 
• **Excitedly** (उत्तेजित रूप से): "Excitedly" means in a way that shows enthusiasm, which is irrelevant to how time is managed.
